title: mg.action
description: client → server → host (relayed inside `relay`). A player's move in a minigame with shared state (placing a part in a slot, playing an evidence card, contributing a patch element, a synchronised tap). The host keeps the shared state and broadcasts it with mg.state. Not used by PARALLEL_SOLO minigames.

a.description: Action name defined by the minigame (e.g. "place", "tap").

x.description: Numeric arguments defined by the minigame (slot index, local timestamp offset in ms, …).

RunId.description: Minigame run identifier chosen by the host; unique within the room.
